description: PUCT (Predictor-UCT) is a selection rule for Monte Carlo tree search that lets a *prior* guide which moves are tried. A child scores its mean reward for the side to move plus `c_puct · prior · √(parent visits) / (1 + child visits)`, so a move with a high prior is explored early and the bonus fades as the child gathers visits. Unlike UCT, it also scores unvisited children, at a mean of one half, so priors decide which moves are tried at all. The priors come from the evaluator, such as a policy network in AlphaZero-style search; without them they are uniform and PUCT explores evenly. `c_puct` is 1.25 by default.
